# CLA signatures

Adding a row below, in a pull request, means I accept the CostGoblin
Contributor License Agreement in [`CLA.md`](../CLA.md), at the version named
in my row, for all my past and future contributions to CostGoblin.

Add your own row at the end of the table, and only your own: the CLA check
rejects a pull request that adds a row for someone who didn't author one of
its commits, or that edits an existing row.

| GitHub | Full name | Date | CLA version |
